summary: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend one public member to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Transit Commission Board.
decided: City Council on April 17 and 18, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Liane Kim to the Toronto Transit Commission Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on June 16, 2027, and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (March 20, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Transit Commission Board. Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (March 20, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Transit Commission Board.

motions.desc: Majority required - CA15.2 - motion by Councillor Cheng

text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend one public member to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Transit Commission Board.

City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (March 20, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Transit Commission Board. Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (March 20, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Transit Commission Board.
